Charge the totem: first an &6offering&r (grain, fruit, vegetables or meat), then a &6seal holding a spirit&r. Use it with an empty hand and you'll respawn at it from anywhere, even another dimension. Each death costs one charge. Totems stack into a column, and sleeping in a bed drops the binding.
quests.lost_light.spirits.soul_lantern.d: &6Soul sand&r is made at the altar: sand and withered matter, 20 dark essence. Four soul sand, potash and lime make a soul glass batch, which is blown into lamp glass. The frame is forged from a nickel ingot.
The lantern is lit like a TFC lamp but fed with spirits: click it with a full seal. Each point of essence is five days of light. A light spirit burns bright, the rest burn dim.
quests.lost_light.spirits.soul_lantern.s: A light that burns on souls
quests.lost_light.spirits.soul_scythe.de: A scythe bound at the altar reaps essence into any seal in your pack, freeing your offhand. It mows and fights like a TFC scythe of the same metal, only slightly faster.
- &6Soul Scythe&r: a black bronze scythe, withered matter, 200 dark essence;
- &6Reaper Scythe&r: a black steel scythe, withered matter twice, 400 dark.
quests.lost_light.spirits.spirit_altar.d: A &6Spirit Altar&r is made from stone and a hide. Once placed it sleeps until a &6seal holding a light spirit&r wakes it; nothing else will do.

The altar stores nothing itself: it draws essence from totems and statues in the 9x9x9 cube around it. There are four essences and they don't replace one another: &6dark&r cuts, rots and curses, &6light&r blesses and heals, &6fey&r grows, &6troll&r works stone and tools.
Open the altar, lay items out in a cross over its five slots and strike the table with a &6bone&r or a holy staff. Nothing extra may be left in the slots.
A &6Spirit Statue&r carved from stone also stores five spirits, but it can't be burned: it's only a supply for the altar. Its face is picked at random and changes nothing.
quests.lost_light.spirits.spirit_totem.d: A seal only carries a spirit, but a &6Spirit Totem&r stores up to five. Use it with a full seal to put a spirit in, and with an empty one to take it back.

A totem can also be burned: heap straw over it and light it, and every spirit inside burns at once and grants a blessing. The fiercer the spirit, the more likely the blessing has a drawback. Fractured spirits left over from rituals give nothing when burned.
quests.lost_light.spirits.title: The Spirit World
quests.lost_light.tfc.alabaster.desc.0: Alabaster is one of the advanced building materials, and it can be dyed in many colors.
quests.lost_light.tfc.alabaster.subtitle: Better than concrete
quests.lost_light.tfc.alabaster.title: Alabaster
quests.lost_light.tfc.animals.desc.0: Almost any TerraFirmaCraft animal can be tamed (just don't try it with crocodiles).
quests.lost_light.tfc.animals.desc.2: Livestock gives resources, mounts carry you across the world, and cats just make home cosier. Find any livestock: a horse, cow, sheep, goat, pig, alpaca, yak or fowl, whatever lives in your lands.
quests.lost_light.tfc.animals.subtitle: Your best friends
quests.lost_light.tfc.animals.title: Animals
quests.lost_light.tfc.aqueducts.desc.0: Stone &6aqueducts&r carry water where you need it: to irrigate fields or drive machines. They're made of bricks and mortar.
quests.lost_light.tfc.aqueducts.subtitle: Water where you need it
quests.lost_light.tfc.aqueducts.title: Aqueducts
quests.lost_light.tfc.automation.desc.0: Some Create-like machines exist right in TerraFirmaCraft. The &6trip hammer&r strikes an anvil on its own, and a water wheel can turn a quern. Worth a try.
quests.lost_light.tfc.automation.subtitl: A straight road to Create. Or is it?
quests.lost_light.tfc.automation.title: Automation
quests.lost_light.tfc.barometer.desc.0: A &6barometer&r shows your height above or below sea level. It's made of brass and glass.
quests.lost_light.tfc.barometer.subtitle: Height above sea level
quests.lost_light.tfc.barometer.title: Barometer
quests.lost_light.tfc.barrels.desc.0: &6Barrels&r store fluids and are used for soaking, brining and tanning.
quests.lost_light.tfc.barrels.subtitle: There's always a pickle to brine
quests.lost_light.tfc.barrels.title: Barrel Business
quests.lost_light.tfc.bed.desc.0: A familiar bed with an unfamiliar recipe: high-quality cloth and lumber. Unlike the thatch bed, it lets you sleep through the night.
quests.lost_light.tfc.bed.subtitle: Finally, some sleep
quests.lost_light.tfc.bed.title: Bed
quests.lost_light.tfc.bellows.desc.0: &6Bellows&r fan the forge fire and raise its temperature. As always, see the &dfield guide&r.
quests.lost_light.tfc.bellows.subtitle: Whooooosh
quests.lost_light.tfc.bellows.title: Bellows
quests.lost_light.tfc.blue_and_red_steel: Blue and red steel are the peak of TerraFirmaCraft metallurgy. Getting them means you've truly beaten the mod. Congratulations, and enjoy a generous reward!
quests.lost_light.tfc.brass.desc.0: &6Brass&r is an alloy of copper and zinc. Brass blocks make a &6pouring table&r for glass, and brass mechanisms are needed for complex devices.
quests.lost_light.tfc.brass.subtitle: For glass and machinery
quests.lost_light.tfc.brass.title: Brass
quests.lost_light.tfc.bronze.desc.0: Bronze is the first real alloy and the material for durable tools. There are three kinds: &6bronze&r (copper and tin), &6bismuth bronze&r (copper, zinc and bismuth) and &6black bronze&r (copper, gold and silver).
quests.lost_light.tfc.bronze.desc.2: Put ore pieces into a vessel in the right ratio and melt it. The ratios are in the &dfield guide&r.
quests.lost_light.tfc.bronze.subtitle: My first alloy
quests.lost_light.tfc.bronze.title: Bronze
quests.lost_light.tfc.canoe.desc.0: There are no vanilla boats in the pack. Your first boat is a &6dugout canoe&r: lay three stripped logs of a soft wood in a row, saw off the top, carve the shape with an axe and burn out the core. See the &dfield guide&r.
quests.lost_light.tfc.canoe.desc.2: A &6canoe paddle&r makes steering easier. Two paddlers go even faster, like the boats of the Fellowship floating down the Great River.
quests.lost_light.tfc.canoe.subtitle: Down the Great River
quests.lost_light.tfc.canoe.title: Dugout Canoe
quests.lost_light.tfc.charcoal_forge.des: The &6charcoal forge&r is the next step after the pit kiln (pottery is still fired in the pit). It heats and melts metal, and also heats a crucible and other furnaces. Keep it fuelled with charcoal!
Forging and smelting need a hot fire. Stack logs into a &6log pile&r in a pit, light it and cover it with dirt to get charcoal. The &dfield guide&r has step-by-step instructions.
Just don't cut the whole forest down: trees remember wrongs, and some of them can walk.
quests.lost_light.tfc.charcoal_pit.title: Charcoal Pit
quests.lost_light.tfc.chiseling.desc.0: A &6hammer&r and a &6chisel&r carve raw stone into stairs, slabs and smooth stone.
quests.lost_light.tfc.chiseling.subtitle: Be like MJ
quests.lost_light.tfc.chiseling.title: Smooth Criminal
quests.lost_light.tfc.clay.desc.0: Clay makes lots of useful things: vessels, molds for casting metal and more.
quests.lost_light.tfc.clay.desc.2: Clay is found in wet biomes and river floodplains, look for grass with a distinct pattern. See the &dfield guide&r for details.
quests.lost_light.tfc.clay.subtitle: You'll find it eventually
quests.lost_light.tfc.clay.title: Clay
quests.lost_light.tfc.concrete.desc.0: &6Concrete powder&r is mixed from sand, gravel and dye. Pour water on it and it sets into solid concrete.
quests.lost_light.tfc.concrete.subtitle: Better than alabaster
quests.lost_light.tfc.concrete.title: Concrete
quests.lost_light.tfc.copper_pickaxe.des: Casting tool heads works just like casting ingots. Keep in mind some molds, like the sword blade, hold more metal.
Melt copper in a vessel, pour it into a pickaxe head mold and assemble the tool with a stick.
quests.lost_light.tfc.crucible.desc.0: A &6crucible&r melts lots of metal at once, mixes alloys and pours into several molds. You also need it to build a blast furnace. See the &dfield guide&r.
quests.lost_light.tfc.crucible.subtitle: Chewie, we're home
quests.lost_light.tfc.crucible.title: Crucible
quests.lost_light.tfc.dairy.desc.0: Cows aren't the only source of milk: Firmalife adds goats and yaks. Right-click a tamed adult female with an empty &6wooden bucket&r.
quests.lost_light.tfc.dairy.subtitle: Drink your milk!
quests.lost_light.tfc.dairy.title: Dairy
quests.lost_light.tfc.daub.desc.0: Cover placed wattle with &6daub&r. Once it sets, right-click with sticks to add a timber frame pattern.
quests.lost_light.tfc.daub.subtitle: And build like a pro
quests.lost_light.tfc.daub.title: Daub It!
quests.lost_light.tfc.fire.desc.0: Fire is one of the most precious gifts Prometheus gave to people. In TerraFirmaCraft it's easy to make.
quests.lost_light.tfc.fire.desc.2: Craft a &6firestarter&r from sticks. Drop a log and three sticks on the ground, then hold right-click on them with the firestarter.
quests.lost_light.tfc.fire.desc.4: A firepit cooks food and lights &6torches&r, and burnt fuel leaves &6wood ash&r behind.
quests.lost_light.tfc.fire.subtitle: Light a fire
quests.lost_light.tfc.fire.title: Gift of Prometheus
quests.lost_light.tfc.first_armor.desc.0: Metal armor is forged in two steps. First an unfinished piece is worked from a &6double sheet&r (boots need a single one), then another sheet is welded onto it. A chestplate needs a double sheet for the second step too.
quests.lost_light.tfc.first_armor.desc.2: The better the metal, the tougher the armor. Start with a copper or bronze chestplate.
quests.lost_light.tfc.first_armor.title: First Armor
quests.lost_light.tfc.first_ores.desc.0: Besides rocks and sticks, the ground holds &6small ore pieces&r. They hint at the vein below. The &dfield guide&r tells where each ore is found.
quests.lost_light.tfc.first_ores.task0: A small piece of copper ore
quests.lost_light.tfc.first_ores.task1: A small piece of tin, bismuth or zinc ore
quests.lost_light.tfc.first_ores.title: First Ores
quests.lost_light.tfc.food.desc.0: Food not only satisfies hunger but also fills your &6nutrition&r, which affects health and strength.
quests.lost_light.tfc.food.desc.2: There are five nutrients: fruit, vegetables, protein, grain and dairy. The higher they all are, the more health you have, and a poor diet lowers it.
quests.lost_light.tfc.food.desc.4: Only recent meals count, so eat a varied diet and keep it up.
quests.lost_light.tfc.food.desc.6: Hunt or fish and cook your catch over a firepit. The beef from quest rewards doesn't count: bring your own game.
quests.lost_light.tfc.food.subtitle: What about second breakfast?
quests.lost_light.tfc.food.task0: 3 pieces of cooked meat or fish (not beef)
quests.lost_light.tfc.food.title: Food
quests.lost_light.tfc.frame_pack.desc.0: The &6frame pack&r is the roomiest Sacks 'n Such storage. The frame is bent from steel rods, and the pack is sewn from reinforced fabric and leather straps.
quests.lost_light.tfc.frame_pack.title: Frame Pack
quests.lost_light.tfc.glass.desc.0: To get glass blocks, pour glass onto a brass &6pouring table&r. Adding powders to the batch tints the glass. Placed glass is removed with a &6gem saw&r.
quests.lost_light.tfc.glass.subtitle: Windows for your home
quests.lost_light.tfc.glass.title: Glass
You'll need bottles to pour your tasty drinks. Let's make a few!
quests.lost_light.tfc.glass_bottle.title: Glassware
A &6blowpipe&r shapes glass items from a hot &6glass batch&r. The batch is mixed from sand, lime and potash or soda ash.
quests.lost_light.tfc.glassblowing.title: Glassblower
quests.lost_light.tfc.grill.desc.0: A &6wrought iron grill&r over the firepit cooks several foods at once.
quests.lost_light.tfc.grill.subtitle: Let's grill
quests.lost_light.tfc.grill.title: Grill
quests.lost_light.tfc.iron_anvil.desc.0: To forge steel you need a wrought iron anvil. Go for it!
quests.lost_light.tfc.iron_anvil.title: Iron Anvil
quests.lost_light.tfc.iron_flask.desc.0: Forge the body of an &6iron flask&r on an anvil and assemble it with a bladder, cloth and leather. It holds much more than the leather one.
quests.lost_light.tfc.iron_flask.title: Iron Flask
quests.lost_light.tfc.iron_tools.desc.0: Iron can't be cast in molds: every tool head is forged on an anvil. Make a knife and shears.
quests.lost_light.tfc.iron_tools.title: Iron Tools
quests.lost_light.tfc.journey_end.desc.0: Colored steel is forged, the sloop is afloat, the Ender Dragon is slain, and songs are sung of your victories.
quests.lost_light.tfc.journey_end.desc.2: You came into this world empty-handed and took all it had to give. From here on, there is only what you invent yourself. The Road goes ever on.
quests.lost_light.tfc.journey_end.subtit: The end of the road, or its middle?
quests.lost_light.tfc.journey_end.task0: Look back at the road behind
quests.lost_light.tfc.journey_end.title: There and Back Again
quests.lost_light.tfc.jug.desc.0: Besides hunger, there is &6thirst&r. You can drink straight from fresh water: right-click it with an empty hand. Salt water only makes thirst worse.
quests.lost_light.tfc.jug.desc.2: To carry water with you, knap a &6jug&r from clay and fire it. Fill the jug from a water source and drink whenever you like.
quests.lost_light.tfc.jug.subtitle: Water, water…
quests.lost_light.tfc.jug.title: Thirst
quests.lost_light.tfc.kaolin_and_graphit: People used to search for kaolin and graphite for days. With the &dfield guide&r and a &6prospector's pick&r it takes much less time: find the right climate and probe the rock.
Kaolin and graphite make &6fire clay&r for the crucible and the blast furnace.
quests.lost_light.tfc.kayak.desc.0: A &6kayak&r is a wooden frame covered with hide. It's lighter than a dugout and can be picked up and carried. The &dfield guide&r explains how to build one.
quests.lost_light.tfc.kayak.subtitle: Light and fast
quests.lost_light.tfc.kayak.title: Kayak
quests.lost_light.tfc.lamps.desc.0: Lamps burn much longer than torches, are easy to refill and can even be carried on your belt. The body is forged on an anvil, and the lamp glass is blown.
quests.lost_light.tfc.lamps.desc.2: Fill it with &6tallow&r or olive oil. Tallow is rendered from blubber in a pot of water.
quests.lost_light.tfc.lamps.subtitle: Just add tallow
quests.lost_light.tfc.lamps.title: Lamps
quests.lost_light.tfc.leather.desc.0: Leather making is described in the &dfield guide&r. In short, you need a hide, limewater in a barrel, tannin and a knife.
quests.lost_light.tfc.leather.subtitle: Leather Men
quests.lost_light.tfc.leather.title: Leather
A &6leather sack&r holds more than a burlap one. Cut the unfinished sack from leather first, then sew it with leather strips and jute.
quests.lost_light.tfc.leather_sack.title: Leather Sack
quests.lost_light.tfc.loom.desc.0: Yarn and fiber become cloth on a &6loom&r: wool yarn gives wool cloth, jute fiber gives burlap. The loom is made of lumber and a stick.
quests.lost_light.tfc.loom.desc.2: Put the threads into the loom and hold right-click until the cloth is done.
quests.lost_light.tfc.loom.subtitle: Thread by thread
quests.lost_light.tfc.loom.title: Loom
quests.lost_light.tfc.metal_anvil.desc.0: Forging needs a &6metal anvil&r, made of double ingots welded on a stone anvil. A copper one is enough to start, but wrought iron needs a bronze anvil.
quests.lost_light.tfc.metal_anvil.title: Metal Anvil
quests.lost_light.tfc.navigation.desc.0: Besides the familiar &6compass&r, a &6sextant&r helps you find your way: it works out exact coordinates from latitude and longitude. Do you really need that?
quests.lost_light.tfc.navigation.title: Navigation
quests.lost_light.tfc.panning.desc.0: Knap a &6pan&r from clay and fire it. Find an &6ore deposit&r: speckled gravel at the bottom of a river or lake. Scoop it with the pan and wash it while standing in water: sometimes ore pieces are left in the pan.
quests.lost_light.tfc.panning.subtitle: Ore hides in rivers
quests.lost_light.tfc.panning.title: Panning
quests.lost_light.tfc.pot.desc.0: A pot over the firepit cooks liquid food. Make a couple of bowls too, or you'll have nothing to serve it in!
quests.lost_light.tfc.pot.subtitle: Let's cook
quests.lost_light.tfc.pot.title: Cooking Pot
quests.lost_light.tfc.powderkeg.desc.0: A &6powderkeg&r is made of lumber, string and red dye. It holds 12 stacks of gunpowder: the more gunpowder, the bigger the blast.
quests.lost_light.tfc.powderkeg.desc.2: Only a sealed keg can be lit. The blast sets off nearby kegs, and every broken block drops as an item, which is handy for quarrying.
quests.lost_light.tfc.powderkeg.subtitle: No smoking
quests.lost_light.tfc.powderkeg.title: Powderkeg
quests.lost_light.tfc.propick.desc.0: Small ore pieces lie within 15 blocks horizontally and 35 vertically of a vein: find the middle of the scatter and the vein is likely beneath you.
quests.lost_light.tfc.propick.desc.2: When there are no pieces, a &6prospector's pick&r helps. Hit a block with it: it checks a 25×25×25 cube around the block and tells which ore is there and how much. The head is cast in a clay mold, like a pickaxe head.
quests.lost_light.tfc.propick.subtitle: What lies beneath?
quests.lost_light.tfc.propick.title: Prospector's Pick
quests.lost_light.tfc.pumps.desc.0: A &6steel pump&r lifts water from a source into aqueducts. It's made of steel pipes, glue and brass mechanisms. See the &dfield guide&r for how to run it.
quests.lost_light.tfc.pumps.subtitle: Best at pumping
quests.lost_light.tfc.pumps.title: Pumps
quests.lost_light.tfc.quern.desc.0: A hand &6quern&r grinds grain into flour and ore into powder, and also yields salt and dyes. The base is made of smooth stone, the handstone of raw stone and a stick.
quests.lost_light.tfc.quern.subtitle: Flour, salt and dyes
quests.lost_light.tfc.quern.title: Quern
quests.lost_light.tfc.raw_rock.desc.0: To get a raw stone block instead of cobblestone, clear all blocks around it on every side. Then it drops whole.
quests.lost_light.tfc.raw_rock.subtitle: Just like the advancement
quests.lost_light.tfc.raw_rock.title: Lonely Stone
quests.lost_light.tfc.sacks.desc.0: &6Sacks 'n Such&r adds portable storage. A &6straw basket&r is woven from straw with a knife, a &6burlap sack&r is sewn from burlap cloth with a needle.
quests.lost_light.tfc.sacks.desc.2: They work right from your inventory, and some can pick up items on their own.
quests.lost_light.tfc.sacks.subtitle: Regards from the Sackville-Bagginses
quests.lost_light.tfc.sacks.title: Baskets and Sacks
quests.lost_light.tfc.saw.desc.0: A saw cuts logs into &6lumber&r, which makes planks, support beams, boats and much more.
quests.lost_light.tfc.saw.subtitle: Can't live without a saw
quests.lost_light.tfc.saw.title: Sawmill
quests.lost_light.tfc.shield.desc.0: A &6shield&r is forged on an anvil from a double sheet of metal. Hold right-click to block a blow or an arrow.
quests.lost_light.tfc.shield.subtitle: The best defence is defence
quests.lost_light.tfc.shield.title: Shield
quests.lost_light.tfc.soup.desc.0: Simple: cook a soup. It combines the nutrition of all its ingredients, so it's a great way to balance your diet.
quests.lost_light.tfc.soup.subtitle: Mmm… delicious!
quests.lost_light.tfc.soup.title: Soup
quests.lost_light.tfc.spindle.desc.0: A &6spindle&r spins wool into yarn, which is woven into cloth for clothes and beds. The head is knapped from clay and fired. See the &dfield guide&r.
quests.lost_light.tfc.spindle.subtitle: No yarn without it
quests.lost_light.tfc.spindle.title: Spindle
quests.lost_light.tfc.steel.desc.0: A &6blast furnace&r turns iron ore into &6pig iron&r. Working pig iron on a wrought iron anvil gives steel. See the &dfield guide&r.
quests.lost_light.tfc.steel.subtitle: Forge and pour
quests.lost_light.tfc.steel.title: Steel
quests.lost_light.tfc.steel_armor.desc.0: Steel armor reliably protects you from predators and enemies. There's no mithril to be found in this world, but steel is serious protection already, and only the colored steels beat it. Start with a helmet.
quests.lost_light.tfc.steel_armor.title: Steel Helmet
quests.lost_light.tfc.steel_buckets.desc: A bucket is forged on an anvil from a sheet of &6red&r or &6blue steel&r. Unlike a wooden one, it places a full water source and can hold lava.
Pick up a few loose rocks. With rocks in hand, right-click to open the &6knapping&r screen and shape a tool head.
This way you can make a knife, an axe and a shovel. A pickaxe or a sword can't be made of stone.
quests.lost_light.tfc.stone_anvil.desc.0: Hit raw igneous stone with a &6hammer&r to turn it into a &6stone anvil&r. It can't forge, only weld ingots, and that's the first step towards a metal anvil.
quests.lost_light.tfc.stone_anvil.title: Stone Anvil
quests.lost_light.tfc.straw_bed.desc.0: People need sleep. Stay awake too long and you'll start yawning, weakening, then seeing things, and those who never rest may have a heart attack.
quests.lost_light.tfc.straw_bed.desc.2: The simplest bed is made of six bunches of &6straw&r. You can sleep at any time of day: the more tired you are, the longer you sleep.
quests.lost_light.tfc.straw_bed.subtitle: Better than bare ground
quests.lost_light.tfc.straw_bed.title: Straw Bed
quests.lost_light.tfc.support_beams.desc: &6Support beams&r protect mines from collapses. Only horizontal beams hold the rock: each protects a 9×5×9 area around it, four blocks to every side. The posts under a beam stand at most five blocks apart. See the &dfield guide&r.
quests.lost_light.tfc.thatch_bed.desc.0: The next step after a straw bed is a thatch bed made of two thatch blocks and a large hide.
quests.lost_light.tfc.thatch_bed.title: Thatch Bed
quests.lost_light.tfc.title: TerraFirmaCraft
quests.lost_light.tfc.vessel.desc.0: Metal is melted in a ceramic &6vessel&r, knapped from clay and fired in a &6pit kiln&r. The &dfield guide&r explains how to build one.
quests.lost_light.tfc.vessel.desc.2: &6Large vessels&r will serve as chests for a while.
quests.lost_light.tfc.vessel.subtitle: The heart of casting
quests.lost_light.tfc.vessel.title: Vessel
quests.lost_light.tfc.water_flask.desc.0: The bladder of large animals makes a handy &6flask&r. It holds much more water than a ceramic jug.
quests.lost_light.tfc.water_flask.desc.2: Later, with wrought iron, you can make an even bigger &6iron flask&r.
quests.lost_light.tfc.water_flask.title: Bladders
quests.lost_light.tfc.water_wheel.desc.0: Flowing water turns a &6water wheel&r, and &6axles&r and &6gearboxes&r carry the rotation to machines. The wheel is made of planks, lumber and an axle.
quests.lost_light.tfc.water_wheel.task0: A water wheel of any wood
quests.lost_light.tfc.water_wheel.title: Water Wheel
quests.lost_light.tfc.wattle.desc.0: &6Wattle&r woven from sticks is the simplest building block and the start of your first buildings.
quests.lost_light.tfc.wattle.subtitle: The frame of your first home
quests.lost_light.tfc.wattle.title: Wattle
quests.lost_light.tfc.welcome.desc.0: The world of &6TerraFirmaCraft&r is harsh: you can't punch trees, food rots, and metal has to be mined, smelted and forged by hand.
quests.lost_light.tfc.welcome.desc.2: These quests walk you through the main stages, from stone tools to blue and red steel. Every mechanic is explained in the &dTerraFirmaCraft field guide&r: take it, you'll need it often.
quests.lost_light.tfc.welcome.desc.4: It's a dangerous business, going out your door: you step onto the road, and there's no knowing where you might be swept off to. Good luck, traveller!
quests.lost_light.tfc.welcome.subtitle: The journey begins
quests.lost_light.tfc.welcome.title: Welcome to Lost Light
quests.lost_light.tfc.wooden_bucket.desc: Unlike metal buckets, a wooden bucket can't create a water source. But it will do for now.
Iron is smelted in a &6bloomery&r made of bronze double sheets. The resulting &6bloom&r is worked into ingots on a bronze anvil. The whole process is in the &dfield guide&r. Here you just claim the reward for your patience.
quests.lost_light.tfc.wrought_iron.title: Wrought Iron
quests.lost_light.title: Quests
quests.lost_light.travel.badlands.desc.0: Red cliffs, dry earth, not a single tree. Orcs dwell in the badlands, and ores hide in their clay layers.
quests.lost_light.travel.badlands.title: Badlands
quests.lost_light.travel.canyons.desc.0: Deep canyons cut through the land. Their walls show layers of rock, a great place to look for ore.
quests.lost_light.travel.canyons.title: Canyons
quests.lost_light.travel.cartographer.de: A compass and a map are a traveller's best friends. Mark what you find: a journey without a map is just a walk.
quests.lost_light.travel.deep_delve.desc: Go below Y −40, down to the roots of the world. Deep ores lie here, and ancient horrors better left undisturbed. Don't forget support beams.
quests.lost_light.travel.deep_delve.subt: Where things best left asleep awaken
quests.lost_light.travel.deep_delve.titl: To the Roots of the Mountains
quests.lost_light.travel.desert.desc.0: In TerraFirmaCraft a desert is not a biome but a climate: hot and almost rainless. Find a place with under 75 mm of rain a year and an average temperature above 15 °C.
quests.lost_light.travel.desert.subtitle: Not a drop of water
quests.lost_light.travel.desert.title: Desert
quests.lost_light.travel.first_steps.des: The world of TerraFirmaCraft is huge and varied: plains and marshes, mountains and volcanoes, deserts and icy wastes. Climate changes with latitude and height: the further north or south, the colder or hotter it gets.
For a start, just walk or run a kilometre. The other quests of this chapter complete when you reach the right place.
quests.lost_light.travel.first_steps.sub: The Road goes ever on from the door
quests.lost_light.travel.first_winter.de: In TerraFirmaCraft the year turns in its course: everything blooms in spring, crops ripen in summer, autumn is time to stock up, and nothing grows in the fields in winter.
Live until winter: December, January or February by the calendar. In the southern hemisphere these months are warm, but the quest still counts. Take care of food and firewood in advance.
Plateaus and highlands lie high above the sea. It's colder and windier here, and you can see far in every direction.
quests.lost_light.travel.highlands.title: Highlands
quests.lost_light.travel.hills.desc.0: Hills and rolling slopes are common in the TFC world. They say somewhere among them there are holes with round doors.
quests.lost_light.travel.hills.subtitle: Green as the Shire
quests.lost_light.travel.hills.title: Hills
quests.lost_light.travel.jungle.desc.0: Humid tropics: an average temperature above 22 °C and over 350 mm of rain a year. Kapoks and bananas grow here, and jaguars roam the thicket.
quests.lost_light.travel.jungle.subtitle: Hot, wet and noisy
quests.lost_light.travel.jungle.title: Rainforest
Travel 100 kilometres on foot: walking or running, but not riding or boating. Your legs ache and your boots are worn, but you've seen more than any hobbit of the Shire.
quests.lost_light.travel.long_road.title: A Hundred Miles
quests.lost_light.travel.marsh.desc.0: In a salt marsh the water is knee-deep and the ground squelches. Reeds and marsh grasses grow here. Don't stare at the lights in the water for too long.
quests.lost_light.travel.marsh.subtitle: Dead lights in the water
quests.lost_light.travel.marsh.title: Salt Marsh
quests.lost_light.travel.mount_doom.desc: 2863 kilometres on foot. That is how far one hobbit walked from a round green door to the fires of Mount Doom: no horse, no boat for most of the way, and a very heavy burden around his neck.
You have walked just as far. You had no Ring to carry, but nobody will send eagles for you either: the way back is on your own two feet.
quests.lost_light.travel.mount_doom.titl: Here at the End of All Things
High and ancient mountains are home to dwarves and dragon legends. The Frostmaw and the Sculptor dwell here, and the best ores hide beneath.
quests.lost_light.travel.mountains.title: Mountains
quests.lost_light.travel.ocean.desc.0: Sail out into the open ocean. Over the reefs the water is warm and clear, further out begin the dark abysses and ocean trenches.
quests.lost_light.travel.ocean.subtitle: The unknown beyond the horizon
quests.lost_light.travel.ocean.title: Open Sea
quests.lost_light.travel.own_waystone.de: Put a waystone by your own home, and any road can end at your doorstep.
The heart of it is a &6warp stone&r made of an ender pearl, amethysts and an emerald. The base is built of stone bricks and obsidian.
quests.lost_light.travel.own_waystone.su: Home is where the stone is
quests.lost_light.travel.plains.desc.0: Plains and lowlands are the best place for your first home and fields. Horses are easy to find and herds easy to graze.
quests.lost_light.travel.plains.subtitle: Where the herds graze
quests.lost_light.travel.plains.title: Wide Plains
quests.lost_light.travel.rider.desc.0: A tamed horse is the best companion on the road. Ride 20 kilometres. Don't forget to feed your steed.
quests.lost_light.travel.rider.subtitle: Ride like the wind
quests.lost_light.travel.rider.title: Rider
quests.lost_light.travel.shore.desc.0: On the shore and tidal flats you can gather clams, mussels and driftwood. Whoever has heard the cry of the gulls will never forget the call of the sea.
quests.lost_light.travel.shore.subtitle: The cry of the gulls
quests.lost_light.travel.shore.title: Seashore
quests.lost_light.travel.spring.desc.0: The snow melts and buds swell on the trees. You've survived your first winter, now it's time to sow the fields.
quests.lost_light.travel.spring.subtitle: Survive winter, survive anything
quests.lost_light.travel.spring.title: Spring Returns
quests.lost_light.travel.summit.desc.0: Climb above 200 blocks. At this height the air is cold and thin, and clouds drift beneath you.
quests.lost_light.travel.summit.subtitle: You can see the whole world from here
quests.lost_light.travel.summit.title: Summit
quests.lost_light.travel.title: Traveller
quests.lost_light.travel.tundra.desc.0: At the cold edge of the world the average temperature is below −12 °C and the ground is frozen through. Caribou and polar bears roam here. Dress warmly.
quests.lost_light.travel.tundra.subtitle: Lands where the snow never melts
quests.lost_light.travel.tundra.title: Permafrost
quests.lost_light.travel.volcano.desc.0: Volcanic mountains smoke, and now and then their craters spew ash and red-hot bombs. Hot springs and rare minerals are born at their feet.
quests.lost_light.travel.volcano.desc.2: Don't even think about throwing anything precious in there.
quests.lost_light.travel.volcano.title: Mountain of Fire
quests.lost_light.travel.waters.desc.0: Rivers run from the mountains to the sea, and mountain lakes lie high among the rocks. Rivers are handy for travelling by boat.
quests.lost_light.travel.waters.subtitle: Water always finds a way
quests.lost_light.travel.waters.title: Rivers and Lakes
quests.lost_light.travel.waystone.desc.0: &6Waystones&r stand in the middle of villages. Touch a waystone (right-click) to remember it, and you'll be able to return to it from another waystone or with a &6return scroll&r.
quests.lost_light.travel.waystone.title: Waystone
quests.lost_light.travel.weather.desc.0: Storms depend on the TerraFirmaCraft climate and the season:
quests.lost_light.travel.weather.desc.1: - &ethunderstorms&r happen in warm humid lands, mostly in summer;
quests.lost_light.travel.weather.desc.2: - &esandstorms&r where less than 100 mm of rain falls a year;
quests.lost_light.travel.weather.desc.5: A &6weather forecast&r block warns about approaching storms, and a &6weather deflector&r keeps them away from your home. Their redstone is ground from cinnabar in a quern.
quests.lost_light.travel.weather.title: A Storm Is Coming
quests.lost_light.travel.wind.desc.0: Weather in this world lives its own life: the wind shifts, clouds gather moisture, and in summer thunderstorms roll over warm humid lands.
quests.lost_light.travel.wind.desc.2: A &6wind vane&r shows the wind direction, and an &6anemometer&r its strength. They're made of sheets and rods of any metal plus a brass mechanism.
quests.lost_light.travel.wind.subtitle: Wind vane and anemometer
quests.lost_light.travel.wind.task0: A wind vane of any metal
quests.lost_light.travel.wind.title: Which Way the Wind Blows
quests.lost_light.villagers.bounty_board: The &6Bounty Board&r in a village holds jobs: bring items or defeat enemies. Take a bounty, complete it before it expires and turn it in at the same board for a reward.
A board can also be built: from lumber, paper, brass mechanisms and a gem.
A &6Decree&r made from paper, sticks, a gold ingot and purple dye sets which bounties the board offers: smithing, hunting, fishing, farming and more. Put the decree into the board.
quests.lost_light.villagers.decree.title: Decree
A baby is carried in your arms until it grows. A grown child helps with chores, and an adult can start a family of their own.
quests.lost_light.villagers.family.title: The Next Generation
quests.lost_light.villagers.friendship.d: Reach 50 hearts with one villager. Gifts help: everyone likes different things, and villagers remember the best gift for a long time. But the same thing gets boring quickly.
quests.lost_light.villagers.marriage.des: First friendship, then courtship. Once you have enough hearts, give an &6Engagement Ring&r of gold and diamond, and then a &6Wedding Ring&r of pure gold.
Your spouse lives with you, and before long there may be children.
quests.lost_light.villagers.mayor.desc.0: Become the mayor of a village. The mayor has more say in the village, but more is expected of you too.
quests.lost_light.villagers.mayor.title: Mayor
quests.lost_light.villagers.new_neighbor: Villagers are living people: each has a name, a personality, a mood and a memory of you. Click a villager to talk: greet them, tell a joke, give a hug, or better not.
Every gesture changes the &6relationship&r in hearts. A good conversation depends on the other person's personality and mood.
quests.lost_light.villagers.perfect_gift: Give a villager what will delight them most. Mind their profession and personality: a smith appreciates metal, and someone with a sweet tooth something tasty.
quests.lost_light.villagers.title: Villagers and Trade
quests.lost_light.villagers.trade.desc.0: There are no emeralds for money here: villagers trade for &6TFC gems&r. The more valuable the gem, the more you get for it. Every profession has its own goods: smiths sell metal, farmers food and seeds, cartographers maps.
quests.lost_light.villagers.trade.desc.2: Gems are mined in ore veins, panned and found in chests.
quests.lost_light.villagers.trade.title: Trade
quests.lost_light.villagers.village_rank: Help a village and it will come to respect you: that earns your first &6rank&r. Ranks bring more say in the village: in time you can become a noble, a mayor and even a monarch.
The village's state, its buildings and your rank are shown by a &6Blueprint&r made of paper and blue dye.
A jobless villager takes a profession when a free &6workstation&r stands nearby: a stonecutter for a mason, a grindstone for a weaponsmith, a cartography table, a smoker for a butcher and so on.
Their recipes here are the pack's own, built on TerraFirmaCraft materials: see JEI. Put a workstation in a village and you get the trader you need.
